issues.detail: The 'Validation list URL' and 'Planning page' point to the County Council's flooding/planning page. That is Lead Local Flood Authority guidance on surface water and flood risk for developers, not a local validation list. The status 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)' hides the fact that the link is the wrong kind of page.

No validation requirements were captured: 0 items and every row says 'Not covered'. As the county planning authority, Hampshire determines minerals and waste applications and its own (Regulation 3) developments, and should have its own validation requirements for these. That list still needs to be found and extracted.

The workbook gives this county council rows for district-level application types: Householder, Listed building consent, Advertisement consent, Works to trees, Permission in principle, Lawful development certificate and others. In two-tier Hampshire the district and borough councils decide these. Only the 'Minerals & waste (county)' and 'County own devt (Reg 3)' rows apply.
